title: Predictable subordination, sharp martingale inequalities and applications
summary: We introduce a new method for obtaining sharp $L^p$ estimates for martingales under predictable analogues of differential subordination. By allowing suitable comparisons between continuous and jump variation adapted to the relevant range of $p$, we retain sharp constants in settings where pathwise differential subordination fails. The key idea is to study together the continuous and jump contributions arising from the appropriate Bellman functions.
